## Transport and Storage

The material should be stored tightly sealed at room temperature. It is recommended to keep the bottle in its cardboard packaging during storage. Direct exposure to sunlight must be avoided. The shelf life is 6 months from the date of shipment, provided the bottle remains sealed.

## Participating Laboratories

The production of the reference material, homogeneity and stability studies, as well as the uncertainty estimation, were carried out at BAM, Department 1.

## Analytical Methods

The certification is based on the gravimetric production process of the material. To confirm the weighing values and to investigate homogeneity and stability, gas chromatographic measurements with flame ionization detection (GC-FID) were performed with BAM reference procedure “Gas chromatographic precision determination (GC-FID) of ethanol in water” [3].

## Metrological Traceability

The certified value (ethanol concentration in g/l at 20 °C) was calculated on a gravimetric basis. The balances are calibrated annually by an external accredited calibration laboratory. A buoyancy correction was applied. The density of the ethanol solution required for the calculation, depending on the ethanol mass fraction, was determined according to [4]. The purity of the ethanol was determined by GC-FID and Karl Fischer titration. The uncertainty of the ethanol concentration value was calculated from the uncertainty budget of the production process and the uncertainty of the purity. The uncertainty estimation was carried out in accordance with the guidelines of the GUM [5].

## Literature

A detailed technical report describing the analysis procedures and the treatment of the analytical data used to certify BAM-K001-K007 is available on request or can be downloaded from https://webshop.bam.de/
